Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual codes (85021310 / 85371090); verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Only 2 export records are visible on the free view, so the export footprint is small and single-buyer (1 trading partner, 1 destination, 1 date); this is a real but thin shipment history, not a broad export programme.
